summary.source: LTAX exports received 19 Oct 2569: PDS 1, 3 and 7 per title (no owner names or taxpayer codes), condo PDS 2/4/8, assessment, payment and debtor registers; owners and extra title links from the 2563 PDS 3 list received 20 Oct 2569

ownersFrom2563.assumption: ownership in the 2563 PDS 3 list is assumed unchanged; 2569 debtor links take precedence

cityTotals.basis: assessment register live unique rows; payment register by tax year in the revenue text; debtor register; municipal notice on 2569 collection

limits: A printed 2569 tax above 3% of the title value is impossible under the Act and is shown as unknown (one title, printed about 100 times too high).
Owners come from the 2563 PDS 3 list and are assumed unchanged; titles sold, inherited or subdivided since 2563 can carry the wrong owner. 2569 debtor links take precedence.
Per-parcel payment cannot be allocated without taxpayer codes; payment status is shown only for debtor-linked titles.
A title matched through house numbers (no deed number in the parcel map) is a weaker link than a deed match.
A 2569 tax of 0 is shown only where the roll proves the title fully exempt; blank tax stays unknown.

buildingJoinedTitles.rule: titles that each hold at least 25% and 20 m2 of one building roof are joined (union across buildings); buildings with more than one house number join nothing; a second title that another building of 40 m2 or more, or a building with a different house number, also stands on is not joined
buildingJoinedTitles.use: s.42 para 2 proxy for titles whose owner is not known; where the 2563 PDS 3 list gives owners, adjoining parcels of one owner form properties (grp)
